login.desktopQr: Scan this QR code with your phone to open PayShare in Nimiq Pay.
login.feature1Sub: You create the group, friends join by QR code, everyone adds their expenses. PayShare does the maths for you.
login.feature2Sub: Your share goes out in NIM from the app. No bank details to ask for, no transfer to wait on. It all confirms in ~2 seconds.
login.feature3Sub: No PayShare account, no password, no fees. You sign in with your Nimiq Pay wallet: no personal data collected, and every transaction stays verifiable on the Nimiq blockchain.
login.feature3Title: Nothing to install, nothing to pay
login.heroSub: With PayShare, you see who owes what in the group and settle up in seconds, no bank needed.
login.inviteHint: If the button doesn't work, copy the link and paste it in Nimiq Pay.
login.inviteSub: Open this link in Nimiq Pay to join the group and settle your shared expenses.

login.storeHint: Don't have Nimiq Pay? You'll be redirected to the store.
login.whySub: Because chasing your friends for three weeks is over: everything gets calculated, everything gets settled.
